title: Table 1.1a Outdoor living area provisions: minimum area (grouped dwellings R2-R25)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Minimum OLA area by coding (grouped R2-R25 only; Chapter 3 Table 1.1a has no R30-R40 rows, which take the PGA). Other columns are constants in the rules: 65% of the required area without permanent roof cover (C1.1.1-r2), 4 m minimum dimension (C1.1.1-r1), behind the street setback area unless C1.1.2 (C1.1.1-r3). Same values as current Table B.
